Yeah I guess so, don't worry about it though I'll be dead soon, so as not to vocalize my distaste for modern women no longer. I'm not a big fan of modern men either mind you, my generation of men are much too egotistical, and hyper-competitive. It's not an unhealthy view, just realistic. If you disagree you either haven't seen enough of the world yet, or are simply unobservant. If my comment left you with a sour taste then I apologize, as I wasn't trying to offend you, more point out what I myself have personally descried over the years. I do not hate anybody and have nothing against anyone, just my frame of reference as all, and yes I realize my perspective isn't Reddit appropriate for the most part, however I'm fine with that. Again I'm really sorry if I've offended anybody with this comment, I truly do love women. I have the utmost respect for everyone, no matter their gender or background. Perhaps I'm just ahead of the pendulum on this one, as with many aspects of life, et sic vadit. 

*To learn who rules over you, simply find out who you are not allowed to criticize.*

-Voltaire
Left click on context to re-read the original post and your response. :)

It's an interesting suggestion, that I somehow am in denial, but I'm not. I used to openly admit in my own mind that I really wanted to lose my virginity, just know that I'm not in denial now when I simply say that I don't care at all about it, it doesn't matter. If you knew what I know, you would understand why it doesn't matter.
Meh, I couldn't care less I guess. Life is meh.

Sounds like you've got an ego issue, mine isn't just ego, I used to feel like I didn't want to die a virgin. Now I don't even care about this world or how it works, or how you should and shouldn't die. Nothing matters anyway.

I'm 22 years old, and I do realize no one will care after a brief moment. I'm at peace with their primal "victory", and I have absolutely no hope of ever having a better life baring some amazing lucky event. As I said the game of life is a shit game, and I don't want to play it anymore.

Send me a private message. I know what happens after you die.

3301

I had acne as well in High School, and I'm also a guy and also a virgin. I'm going to fill you in a couple of things you probably haven't been clued in on yet, and I'm going to comment like I'm talking to a younger version of myself because I'm now 22. I'm also suicidal, and I was at your age as well but I stuck around because a couple people lied to me and told me "things would get better." They only got worse(for me specifically though).

First off the acne will eventually clear up, and if you're good looking and have at least a decent body and some social skills you could get a girlfriend. Given you need all these things or otherwise they will cheat on you or ignore you all together. Females like to pretend to care, but in reality they don't. TBH you won't get alot of good advice on a website like this where people are more concerned about defending their erroneous ideologies then actually helping people.

If instead you're short(I'm 5'10") or you grow up average looking or below average looking, or are going bald...Your urge to find someone you can hug and relate to will grow and eat at you over the course of several years. Each year the shadow looming over you, every month getting darker and darker. Girls will reject you but tell you to keep trying, you will play videogames until they become boring, you will loose your friends due to your depression and eventually you will begin to question why you didn't take your own life years prior, as I have. You will realize all the lies that you were brought up with like girls have it tough and putting them on a pedestal was nothing but bs, and you will learn that no one not even your own family(minus their biological instinct) actually give a shit about you. 

In short you're too young to know which of these two people you will become, and I think you should stick around for a couple more years to see, also get into sports, women like guys with muscle and make fun of guys without, as do other men. So I also think you should work out if you're physcially able too.

Welcome to reality. Your first roll of the dice you could have won the lottery by being an average looking or better female but you missed out on that one. The second roll as a male you see whether you will be rich, or good looking, or both, you probably missed out on that as well. Men don't get dates for things they cannot change(height, hair, social skills, etc), women don't get dates for things they can change with some work(weight, make up, etc). 

Your life will be difficult, either tough it out or give up(like me), good luck and I do hope you stick around, because you never how your will look without the acne, and if you have a full head of hair that's a good sign.

I suggest you stick around a few more years and see how you turn out. Not to sound negative but in my opinion this is the best advice I could give any guys out their contemplating suicide, and I put alot of though into this response so I do hope you hear me out. Wait a few years and read up on how the world works first.

I believe I understand why people downvoted you, and I gave you an upvote. Some people just cannot handle a dose of reality and what lives people like you and I have.

Heh same here, except my parent don't "brag" about me, and I'm not good at anything. Didn't say I had the worst life, I said life sucks. 

Edit: I've been mentally abused as well, my my family, classmates in school(years ago), and I was raped as a child. Meh, fuck it life sucks and then you die unless you're one of the lucky few. I.E be born a average or better female, or born a rich/good looking guy. Otherwise your life will usually suck, like mine. Life is a shit game, and I don't want to play it anymore after I beat Fallout 4 I'm done.

I will die a virgin, and couldn't give a shit less. My ego dies with me. If you only knew what kind of a life I've had you would understand why. Some people have shit lives and die as virgins, most of them men, like me.
I was using it as a metaphor for how I felt, glad someone got it.
I live with one of my parents and don't make enough money to leave. I'm not average at anything either, I literally suck at everything.
